about: The codes Care Management's rules name, with the minutes CMS sets for each (MLN909188, MLN909432, the CCM and BHI FAQs, and the CY 2025-2026 physician fee schedule rules; see src/Domain/Service.php). CPT numbers only, with labels in our own words, never AMA's descriptions (Seth, 2026-10-24). HCPCS Level II codes are CMS's.
terms: CPT is a registered trademark of the American Medical Association. No CPT descriptor is reproduced here; the labels are ours (CC0). HCPCS Level II codes are published by CMS.
